analyst_view.overall: Early view: The Revierderby, with promoted Schalke near the bottom and yet to score in a home league game this season, against a Dortmund side built on the league's best defence. Derby intensity should push the card count up, but both teams' games point to few goals.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.0 goals. Schalke's home attack has not scored and Dortmund's games are usually tight, while derbies can break open late; nothing pushes me away from the number.

corners.text: The site expects 9.7 corners, 5.6 for Dortmund. Schalke will defend deep and Dortmund will have the ball, which fits the number, so I stay level.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. I lean higher because this is the Revierderby: Schalke at home will be aggressive, and Dortmund had three players booked even in a calm home win over Elversberg.

shots.text: The site has 24.7 shots. Schalke have been blunt at home and Dortmund tend to control games without piling up attempts, so I lean slightly lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 on target. Schalke's home finishing and Dortmund's control point to few clear chances, so I lean slightly lower.
